Today, the name is given as a reminder to individuals to strive towards morally pure and esteemed living, upholding the same qualities of admirable conduct and dignity.

The name "Noble" can serve as a reminder to cultivate and maintain the divine virtues within, as given in the teachings of Christianity. By emulating the noble character of Jesus and other holy figures, one can live a life in accordance with faith and remain true to God. Additionally, the virtue of nobility highlights the inherent worth and dignity of every human being created in God's image, prompting us to treat others with kindness, compassion, and respect.
